description: Test suite for language hint filtering and normalization functions in a diff viewer context, using Vitest framework.

methods.name: filterSupportedLanguageHints
methods.description: Filters a list of language hints to include only supported ones, falling back to 'text'.

methods.name: normalizeDiffViewerPayloadLanguages
methods.description: Normalizes language hints in diff payloads, replacing unsupported languages with 'text'.
